description: base/base mempool: the default ValiditySignatureMode is Off, so anyone can re-submit a victim's signed transaction via base_sendRawTransactionValidity with never-satisfiable validity predicates and no sender signature. The victim's transaction is parked in the validity pool — never buildable until its block bound, about 60 seconds — and a plain resubmission is rejected as underpriced, so the victim must re-sign at a higher fee. This is a single-transaction delay, not network-wide censorship. The issue is not in KI-02 through KI-57, nor in Cantina KI-34 through KI-46.
poc_notes: Devnet PoC blocked (no bridge driver in the VM kernel); analysis is from the base/base source: default ValiditySignatureMode Off, base_sendRawTransactionValidity accepts predicates without a sender signature, parked transactions are never buildable until the block bound.
title: Unsigned validity predicates let anyone park a victim's transaction in the validity pool
